name: Bethly Rose Daisley
original_name: ベスリー・ローズ・ディズリー
source:
"Transfer Student from the Northern Country (北の国からの転校生)"

A transfer student who has come from Canada. Her long blonde, straight hair and clear blue eyes leave a strong impression on people.
She is calm and doesn't show her emotions too much. Because she's still learning Japanese, Bethly talks using only the absolute minimum of words which makes her leave a cool and emotionless impression.

But her actual personality is the opposite of her cold appearance, she is very delicate and kind.

Bethly is great at drawing.
